S: Corn arepas filled with melted mozzarella, griddled golden
Pre-cooked corn flour mixed with warm water, salt and butter, shaped into discs, filled with grated mozzarella, cooked on a griddle until golden and crisp.
Colombian cheese bread rolls with tapioca and feta, baked puffed and golden
Tapioca starch, corn flour, feta and egg mixed into a dough, rolled into balls, baked at 200C for 15 minutes until puffed and golden.
the flowers that bloom wherever she goes

Zucchini flowers filled with ricotta, feta and lemon zest, dipped in a light batter and fried crisp, with a drizzle of honey and fresh lime. Mix 200g ricotta, 80g crumbled feta, the zest of a lime, chopped mint and pepper. Gently open 12 zucchini flowers, remove the stamens and pipe in the filling, twisting the petals to close. Whisk 100g plain flour, 30g cornflour and 180ml cold sparkling water into a batter. Heat oil to 180C, dip the flowers and fry in batches for 2 to 3 minutes until crisp. Drain, salt lightly, drizzle with honey and serve with lime wedges.
M: Dolores heard you were hungry before you did

Chicken simmered with three kinds of potato and corn on the cob until the soup thickens, served with cream, capers, avocado and a little rice. Put 1kg chicken thighs on the bone in a pot with 2.5 litres water, 1 onion, 3 garlic cloves, a bunch of coriander stems and 2 tsp salt. Simmer 40 minutes, then lift out the chicken and shred it. Add 500g diced white potatoes, 500g diced chat potatoes and 300g diced sweet potato with 4 corn cobs in thirds and simmer 40 minutes until the soup thickens. Return the chicken and add 1 tbsp dried oregano. Serve with cream, capers, sliced avocado and rice.

Beef chuck braised in tomato, onion and cumin until shredded, with rice, black beans, fried plantain and a fried egg.

Crumbled feta and fresh cheese mixed with cornflour, tapioca starch, egg and a little sugar into a soft dough, rolled into balls, fried at 160C for 6 minutes until golden and round.
K: Hot dark chocolate with a cube of mozzarella melting in each mug
Dark chocolate whisked into hot milk with a little cinnamon until frothy, a cube of mozzarella dropped into each mug to go soft and stringy.

Cook the rice and warm the black beans.

s.note: Corn arepas filled with melted mozzarella, griddled golden
s.how: Mix 250g arepa flour with 350ml warm water, salt and 30g butter into a soft dough. Shape 8 discs, fill with 150g grated mozzarella and seal. Cook on a griddle for 5 minutes a side until golden and crisp.

s.note: Colombian cheese bread rolls with tapioca and feta, baked puffed and golden
s.how: Mix 150g tapioca starch, 50g arepa flour, 250g crumbled feta, 1 egg and 1 tbsp sugar into a soft dough. Roll into 12 balls and bake at 200C for 15 minutes until puffed and golden. Eat warm.

m.n: Shredded beef, rice, beans and plantains
m.note: Cumin braised shredded beef with rice, black beans and fried green plantain
m.how: Braise 1.2kg beef chuck with a tin of tomatoes, 2 onions and 2 tsp cumin for 3 hours, then shred. Cook 300g rice and warm 2 tins black beans. Fry slices of 2 green plantains and 4 eggs. Serve it all on one plate.

w.note: Fried cheese dough balls, crisp outside and soft inside
w.how: Mix 250g crumbled feta, 60g cornflour, 60g tapioca starch, 1 egg and 2 tbsp sugar into a soft dough. Roll into 16 balls and fry at 160C for 6 minutes until golden and round. Drain and serve warm.

d.note: Hot dark chocolate with a cube of mozzarella melting in each mug
d.how: Heat 1L milk and whisk in 150g dark chocolate and a pinch of cinnamon until frothy. Pour into four mugs and drop a cube of mozzarella into each so it goes soft and stringy, then fish it out with a spoon.
